title: अंश १ · अध्याय ३

items.speaker: '''श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
निर्गुणस्याप्रमेयस्य शुद्धस्याप्यमलात्मनः ।
कथं सर्गादिकर्तृत्वं ब्रह्मणोऽभ्युपगम्यते ॥१॥
items.tr:
nirguṇasyāprameyasya śuddhasyāpyamalātmanaḥ |
kathaṃ sargādikartṛtvaṃ brahmaṇo'bhyupagamyate ||1||

items.speaker: '''श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
शक्तयः सर्वभावानामचिन्त्यज्ञानगोचराः ।
यतोऽतो ब्रह्मणस्तास्तु सर्गाद्या भावशक्तयः ।
भवन्ति तपतां श्रेष्ठ पावकस्य यथोष्णता ॥२॥
items.tr:
śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānāmacintyajñānagocarāḥ |
yato'to brahmaṇastāstu sargādyā bhāvaśaktayaḥ |
bhavanti tapatāṃ śreṣṭha pāvakasya yathoṣṇatā ||2||

items.text:
तन्निबोध यथा सर्गे भगवान्सम्प्रवर्त्तते ।
नारायणाख्यो भगवान्ब्रह्म लोकपितामहः ॥३॥
items.tr:
tannibodha yathā sarge bhagavānsampravarttate |
nārāyaṇākhyo bhagavānbrahma lokapitāmahaḥ ||3||

items.text: उप्तन्नः प्रोच्यते विद्वन्नित्यमेवोपचारतः ॥४॥
items.tr: uptannaḥ procyate vidvannityamevopacārataḥ ||4||

items.text:
निजेन तस्य मानेन आयुर्वर्षशतं स्मृतम् ।
तत्पराख्यं तदर्द्ध च परार्द्धमभिधीयते ॥५॥
items.tr:
nijena tasya mānena āyurvarṣaśataṃ smṛtam |
tatparākhyaṃ tadarddha ca parārddhamabhidhīyate ||5||

items.text:
कालस्वरूपं विष्णोश्च यन्मयोक्तं तवानघ ।
तेन तस्य निबोध त्वं परिमाणोपपादनम् ॥६॥
items.tr:
kālasvarūpaṃ viṣṇośca yanmayoktaṃ tavānagha |
tena tasya nibodha tvaṃ parimāṇopapādanam ||6||

items.text:
अन्येषां चैव जन्तूनां चराणामचराश्च ये ।
भूभूभृत्सागरादीनामशेषाणां च सत्तम ॥७॥
items.tr:
anyeṣāṃ caiva jantūnāṃ carāṇāmacarāśca ye |
bhūbhūbhṛtsāgarādīnāmaśeṣāṇāṃ ca sattama ||7||

items.text:
काष्ठा पत्र्चदशाख्याता निमेषा मुनिसत्तम ।
काष्ठा पत्र्चदशाख्याता निमेषा मनिसत्तम ।
काष्ठा त्रिंशत्कला त्रिंशत्कला मौहूर्तिको विधिः ॥८॥
items.tr:
kāṣṭhā patrcadaśākhyātā nimeṣā munisattama |
kāṣṭhā patrcadaśākhyātā nimeṣā manisattama |
kāṣṭhā triṃśatkalā triṃśatkalā mauhūrtiko vidhiḥ ||8||

items.text:
तावत्संख्यैरहोरात्रं मुहूर्तैर्मानुषं स्मृतम् ।
अहोरात्राणि तावानित मासः पक्षद्वयात्मकः ॥९॥
items.tr:
tāvatsaṃkhyairahorātraṃ muhūrtairmānuṣaṃ smṛtam |
ahorātrāṇi tāvānita māsaḥ pakṣadvayātmakaḥ ||9||

items.text:
तैः षड्‌भिरयनं वर्ष द्वेऽयनें दक्षिणोत्तरे ।
अयनं दक्षिणं रात्रिर्देवानामुत्तरं दिनम् ॥१०॥
items.tr:
taiḥ ṣaḍbhirayanaṃ varṣa dve'yaneṃ dakṣiṇottare |
ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ rātrirdevānāmuttaraṃ dinam ||10||

items.text:
दिव्यैर्वर्षसहस्त्रैस्तु कृतत्रेतदिसंज्ञितम् ।
चतुर्युगं द्वादशभिस्तद्विभागं निबोध मे ॥११॥
items.tr:
divyairvarṣasahastraistu kṛtatretadisaṃjñitam |
caturyugaṃ dvādaśabhistadvibhāgaṃ nibodha me ||11||

items.text:
चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वै चैकं कृतादिषु यथाक्रमम् ।
दिव्याब्दानां सहस्त्राणि युगेष्वाहुः पुराविदः ॥१२॥
items.tr:
catvāri trīṇi dvai caikaṃ kṛtādiṣu yathākramam |
divyābdānāṃ sahastrāṇi yugeṣvāhuḥ purāvidaḥ ||12||

items.text:
तत्प्रमाणैः शतैः सन्ध्या पूर्वा तत्राभिधीयते ।
सन्ध्यांशश्चैव तत्तुल्यो युगस्यानन्तरो हि सः ॥१३॥
items.tr:
tatpramāṇaiḥ śataiḥ sandhyā pūrvā tatrābhidhīyate |
sandhyāṃśaścaiva tattulyo yugasyānantaro hi saḥ ||13||

items.text:
सन्ध्यासध्यांशयोरन्तर्यः कालो मुनिसत्तम ।
युगाख्यः स तु विज्ञेयः कृतत्रेतादिसंज्ञितः ॥१४॥
items.tr:
sandhyāsadhyāṃśayorantaryaḥ kālo munisattama |
yugākhyaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ kṛtatretādisaṃjñitaḥ ||14||

items.text:
कृतं त्रेता द्वाररश्च कलिश्चैव चतुर्युगम् ।
प्रोच्यते तस्तहस्त्र च ब्रह्मणो दिवसं मुने ॥१५॥
items.tr:
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāraraśca kaliścaiva caturyugam |
procyate tastahastra ca brahmaṇo divasaṃ mune ||15||

items.text:
ब्रह्मणो दिवसे ब्रह्मन्मनवस्तु चतुर्दश ।
भवन्ति परिमाणं च तेषां कालकृतं श्रृणु ॥१६॥
items.tr:
brahmaṇo divase brahmanmanavastu caturdaśa |
bhavanti parimāṇaṃ ca teṣāṃ kālakṛtaṃ śrṛṇu ||16||

items.text:
सप्तर्षयः सुराः शक्रो मनुस्तत्सूनवो नृपाः ।
एककाले हि सृज्यन्ते संह्रियन्ते च पूर्ववत् ॥१७॥
items.tr:
saptarṣayaḥ surāḥ śakro manustatsūnavo nṛpāḥ |
ekakāle hi sṛjyante saṃhriyante ca pūrvavat ||17||

items.text:
चतुर्यगुणां संख्याता साधिका ह्रोकासप्ततिः ।
मन्वन्तरं मनोः कालः सुरादीनां च सत्तम ॥१८॥
items.tr:
caturyaguṇāṃ saṃkhyātā sādhikā hrokāsaptatiḥ |
manvantaraṃ manoḥ kālaḥ surādīnāṃ ca sattama ||18||

items.text:
अष्टौ शत सहस्त्राणि दिव्ययां संख्यया स्मृतम् ।
द्विपत्रचाशत्तथान्यानि सहस्त्राण्यधिकानि तु ॥१९॥
items.tr:
aṣṭau śata sahastrāṇi divyayāṃ saṃkhyayā smṛtam |
dvipatracāśattathānyāni sahastrāṇyadhikāni tu ||19||

items.text:
त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तु सम्पूर्णाः संख्याताः संख्याया द्विज ।
सप्तषष्टिस्तथान्यानि नियुतानि महामुने ॥२०॥
items.tr:
triṃśatkoṭyastu sampūrṇāḥ saṃkhyātāḥ saṃkhyāyā dvija |
saptaṣaṣṭistathānyāni niyutāni mahāmune ||20||

items.text:
विंशतिस्तु सह्स्त्राणि कालोऽयमधिकं विना ।
मन्वन्तरस्य सड्खयेयं मानुषैर्वत्सरैर्द्विज ॥२१॥
items.tr:
viṃśatistu sahstrāṇi kālo'yamadhikaṃ vinā |
manvantarasya saḍkhayeyaṃ mānuṣairvatsarairdvija ||21||

items.text:
चतुर्दशगुणो ह्योष कालो ब्राह्ममहः स्मृतम् ।
ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिको नाम तस्यान्ते प्रतिसत्र्चरः ॥२२॥
items.tr:
caturdaśaguṇo hyoṣa kālo brāhmamahaḥ smṛtam |
brāhmo naimittiko nāma tasyānte pratisatrcaraḥ ||22||

items.text:
तदा ही दह्राते सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं भूर्भुवादिकम् ।
जनं प्रयान्ति तापार्था महर्लोकनिवासिनः ॥२३॥
items.tr:
tadā hī dahrāte sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam |
janaṃ prayānti tāpārthā maharlokanivāsinaḥ ||23||

items.text:
एकार्णवे तु त्रैलोक्ये ब्रह्म नारायणात्मकः ।
भोगिशय्यां गतः शेते त्रैलोक्यग्रासबृंहितः ॥२४॥
items.tr:
ekārṇave tu trailokye brahma nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
bhogiśayyāṃ gataḥ śete trailokyagrāsabṛṃhitaḥ ||24||

items.text:
जनस्थैर्योगिभिर्देवाश्चिन्त्यमानोऽब्जसम्भवः ।
तत्प्रमाणां हि तां रात्रिं तदन्ते सृजते पुनः ॥२५॥
items.tr:
janasthairyogibhirdevāścintyamāno'bjasambhavaḥ |
tatpramāṇāṃ hi tāṃ rātriṃ tadante sṛjate punaḥ ||25||

items.text:
एवं तु ब्रह्मणो वर्षमेवं वर्षशतं च यत् ।
शतं हि तस्य वर्षाणां परमायुर्महात्मनः ॥२६॥
items.tr:
evaṃ tu brahmaṇo varṣamevaṃ varṣaśataṃ ca yat |
śataṃ hi tasya varṣāṇāṃ paramāyurmahātmanaḥ ||26||

items.text:
एकमस्य व्यतीतं तु परार्द्ध ब्रह्मणोऽनघ ।
तस्यान्तेऽभून्महाकल्पः पाद्य इत्यभिविश्रुतः ॥२७॥
items.tr:
ekamasya vyatītaṃ tu parārddha brahmaṇo'nagha |
tasyānte'bhūnmahākalpaḥ pādya ityabhiviśrutaḥ ||27||

items.text:
द्वितीयस्य परार्द्धस्य वर्तमानस्य वै द्विज ।
वाराह इति कल्पोऽयं प्रथमः परिकीर्तितः ॥२८॥
items.tr:
dvitīyasya parārddhasya vartamānasya vai dvija |
vārāha iti kalpo'yaṃ prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||28||

en_chapter: Maitreya said:—"How can Brahmā, who is devoid of quality and confineless and pure and unblamed of soul, possibly engage in creation, etc.?" Thereat Parāçara said,—"As the powers of many an object are incomprehensible and incapable of being construed to sense, the powers of creation etc., possessed by Brahmā, like the heat of fire, are also so. O foremost of ascetics, hearken how the Professor of the eight kinds of wealth becomes engaged in creation. O wise one, in consequence of the eternal reverend Vishnu coming into being from objects, as Brahmā the Grand-father, he is designated as produced. According to the measure set by him human life is known as consisting of an hundred years. This (age) is called para, and the half thereof Parārdha. O sinless one, do thou listen to me as I mention unto thee the divisions of that which I have named unto thee as the Time-form of Vishnu,—in relation to Him as well as other creatures, and mobile and immobile objects, and the seas and all other things, O best of men. O chief of ascetics, a kāsthā is composed of fifteen nimeshas; thirty kāsthās make up a kalā; and thirty kalās a muhurta; and as many muhurtas make up a day and a night unto human beings. As many days and nights form a month; and a month consists of two fortnights. Six months form an ayana; and a year is composed of two ayanas, one northern, the other southern. The southern ayana is the night of the celestials, as the northern is their day. The period of twelve thousand years of the deities constitute the four Yugas, viz. Krita, Tretā, and the others. Do thou understand that. Chronologists say that four, three, two, and one thousand divine years successively compose Krita and the other Yugas. An hundred divine years are said to constitute the first twilight, as another hundred years the last, of the Yuga. The space that intervenes between these twilights goeth by the name of Yuga, embracing Krita, Tretā and the rest. And O anchoret, a thousand of the four Yugas, Krita, Tretā, Dwāpara and Kali, constitute one day of Brahmā. One day of Brahmā O Brāhmana, compriseth four and ten reigns of the Manus. Listen to the chronology thereof! The seven saints, the celestials, Sakra, Manu, and his sons—kings all of them—are created at the same time and, as formerly, are destroyed at the same time, O excellent one, a little over seventy-one four Yugas constitute a Manwantara—the period of Manu as well as the gods. Manwantara takes up over eight lakshas and fifty-two thousand years; and, O twice-born one, full thirty kotis above sixty-seven niyutas and about twenty thousand human years. Ten and fourteen such periods form one day of Brahmā. Then comes on his sleep and at the end thereof, the universal dissolution. And then all the triune world, comprising Bhur, Bhuva and the rest, are in conflagration, and the dwellers of the regions of Maha, exercised with the heat, resort to the regions of Jana. On the three regions being reduced to one sheet of sea, that deity, the lotus-sprung Brahmā instinct with Nārāyana, contemplated by the Yogis of Janasthāna,—with the intention of swallowing up the three worlds,—lieth down on the bed (formed by) the serpent. And having spent the night measuring that period, at the end thereof he begins anew the work of creation. This is the year of Brahmā and thus is the space of his hundred years; and the life of that high-souled one is an hundred (such) years. O thou without sin, one half of Brahmās life is spent. On the expiration thereof passeth away a Mahākalpa—which is called Pādma. O twice-born one, this is the Kalpa distinguished as Vatrahā belonging to the second Parāddha, which is present".
